content.en_us:
How to get it :
- Crafting table (x6) : [[gv:billet_beryllium|Beryllium Billet]].
- Crafting table (x9) : [[gv:ingot_beryllium|Beryllium Ingot]].
- [[PUREX|PUREX]] (x2) : [[gv:waste_schrabidium|Depleted Schrabidium Fuel]], 500 mB kerosene, 250 mB nitric acid.

Used to make :
[[gv:billet_po210be|Po210Be Billet]], [[gv:billet_pu238be|Pu238Be Billet]], [[gv:billet_ra226be|Ra226Be Billet]], [[gv:billet_schrabidium_fuel|Schrabidium Fuel Billet]], [[gv:ingot_beryllium|Beryllium Ingot]], [[gv:ingot_hes|Highly Enriched Schrabidium Fuel Ingot]], [[gv:ingot_les|Low Enriched Schrabidium Fuel Ingot]], [[gv:ingot_schrabidium_fuel|Ingot of Schrabidium Fuel]].
